identity.name: Llama-3.1-8B
identity.summary: An 8B-parameter multilingual large language model from the Meta Llama 3.1 collection, supporting text-in/text-out generation.

possible_risks.description: Lack of model transparency is due to insufficient documentation of the model design, development, and evaluation process and the absence of insights into the inner workings of the model.
possible_risks.justification: Card gives only architecture size, modality, and training-data mix; no design, development, or evaluation details are reported for this checkpoint.

possible_risks.description: Lack of data transparency might be due to insufficient documentation of training or tuning dataset details, including synthetic data generation.
possible_risks.justification: Training data is described only as 'a new mix of publicly available online data' with no dataset details, curation, or documentation.

possible_risks.description: Data provenance refers to the traceability of data (including synthetic data), which includes its ownership, origin, transformations, and generation. Proving that the data is the same as the original source with correct usage terms is difficult without standardized methods for verifying data sources or generation.
possible_risks.justification: The card does not provide traceability or source verification for the 'publicly available online data' mix, so data origin and usage terms are uncertain.

possible_risks.description: Terms of service, license compliance, or other IP issues may restrict the ability to use certain data for building models.
possible_risks.justification: Because the training data is only broadly described as publicly available online data, the card does not establish license or terms-of-service compliance for that data.

specifications.model_size: 15.0 GiB of safetensors weights (16,060,556,376 bytes) in BF16

training_context.training_data: The checkpoint was trained on a new mix of publicly available online data.
